structured.approach: I followed DS-04 in the data-science-steps skill. I read all six contracted inputs. For feat.stories, feat.prd and feat.trd I read only the Data Science parts (STORY-03 and STORY-04, AC-7 to AC-12, IF-3 and IF-4, T-5 to T-7). I also read the approved background outputs with context_get: task.secrets_scope (DS-02), task.db_changes (DS-03) and feat.clarifications (DES-03). Then I read the existing ap_forecast code: the tool view, ci.py and README.md. I used CodeGraph to check which callers depend on build_explanation_request, predict_delay_days and load_config. I mapped TSK-03 and TSK-04 onto the smallest set of files allowed by each task's file budget and wrote a minimal code sketch for each component. I listed the layers that do not change: predict.py, models.json, CI, storage, secrets and the other repositories. A verifier subagent checked the draft against the cited sources. I then fixed what it found: the per-environment secrets wording (SSQ-2 is still open), wrong section references for TA-3 and TA-4, the approval status of feat.tasks (cited from the journey board, with TKQ-2 still open), two inferences now labelled as agent judgement, and the diagram sources.

claims.text: The Data Science lane has two tasks, both in ap_forecast: TSK-03 (STORY-03, new risk.vendor_risk) and TSK-04 (STORY-04, build_explanation_request gains risk=None).

TSK-03 creates a new module src/ap_forecast/risk.py with HIGH_ABOVE_DAYS = 30, MEDIUM_ABOVE_DAYS = 10 and vendor_risk(history: Iterable[int]) -> str. It returns 'high' when the prediction is > 30, 'medium' when > 10, else 'low'. risk.py imports only predict_delay_days and never explain.
vendor_risk must call predict_delay_days exactly once so that a generator history works, and it does not validate history values.

TSK-04 changes explain.py only by adding risk=None as the last parameter and appending f" Risk level: {risk}." when risk is not None. Provider, model and max_tokens still come from config or load_config().
src/ap_forecast/__init__.py imports vendor_risk, adds it to __all__, and takes one version step from 0.9.0. TSK-03 owns that step.

The new tests go in tests/test_risk.py: levels, the boundaries [30], [31], [10] and [11], empty and early-only histories, no LLM, and the export. tests/test_forecast.py gains test_request_with_risk and test_request_without_risk_unchanged. The three existing tests stay unchanged.
Inside ap_forecast, the only callers of build_explanation_request and predict_delay_days are the __init__.py re-export and tests/test_forecast.py.
predict.py, models.json (provider acme-llm, model acme-text-2, max_tokens 300), ci.py, README.md and CLAUDE.md are unchanged.
CI compiles src, discovers tests under tests/, gates coverage at 90.0, and flags print, eval, exec, bare except and lines over 140 characters in src/ap_forecast/*.py.
No database change is required for the Data Science tasks.
No secrets are required or granted for the ap_forecast repository. The per-environment confirmation is still open as SSQ-2.
No other lane imports the ap_forecast package. The other lanes build against the DC-2 and DC-3 contracts.

feat.stories TK-03.2 proposes putting the risk tests in tests/test_forecast.py, while feat.tasks puts them in a new tests/test_risk.py. Both feat.design B2.5 and CL-X4 allow either, and TKQ-2 is still open for the Developer.
The repository is on branch feature/story with write access, and the CI command is /usr/bin/python3 ci.py.

open_questions: DSQ-1 (non-blocking): which version number replaces 0.9.0? feat.design DD-11 asks for a minor step that the lane confirms, and no input gives the number. Owner: Developer.

Carried, non-blocking: TQ-4 / CQ-4 (meaning of 'given' for risk), TQ-5 (early payments counted as 0), TQ-8 (risk label sent to acme-llm), PQ-1 (empty history), PQ-5 (order against PROV-ACME-2026-11), RAQ-1 to RAQ-3 (task.repo_access), SSQ-1 and SSQ-2 (secrets per environment, from task.secrets_scope), TKQ-2 (test-file split).
structured.summary: task.components lists five file changes in ap_forecast and nothing outside it. The new files are src/ap_forecast/risk.py (vendor_risk with the 30 and 10 thresholds; TSK-03) and tests/test_risk.py. explain.py gets risk=None as its last parameter and one conditional append to the prompt (TSK-04). __init__.py exports vendor_risk and takes the version step from 0.9.0. tests/test_forecast.py gets two new tests. The file includes a minimal code sketch for each change and the existing-code walkthrough behind it. predict.py, models.json, CI, storage and the other repositories stay unchanged. The repository needs no secrets and no database change; confirming secrets for every environment is still open as SSQ-2. There are no blocking questions; DSQ-1 (the next version number) is for the Developer.
